name: 雛菜
text:
今日は間に合いそうって
思ったんだけどな～？
trans: And I thought that maybe I'd make it in time today～?

name: 雛菜
trans:
Shh～!
You'll get me caught, y'know～......?

name: 雛菜
text:
なんか１限間に合うと思ったら
ぎりぎり間に合わなくて～
trans:
I thought I'd make it to the first period, but I still
missed it barely ～

name: 雛菜
text:
こっそり学校探検してたら、
透先輩発見～～～♡
trans:
So I was exploring the school secretly, and  found
Toru-senpai～～～♡

name: 雛菜
text:
……透先輩はこんな
すみっこで体育見学？
trans:
......Are you sitting out PE in a corner like this,
Toru-senpai?

name: 雛菜
text:
雛菜がおんなじクラスだったら
雛菜のジャージ貸してあげたのに～……
trans:
If you were the same class as Hinana, Hinana would
have lent you her jersey～......

name: 雛菜
text:
そしたら雛菜は見学で～
透先輩のこと見てる！
trans:
Hinana will then be the one sitting out～
And I'll keep looking at Toru-senpai!

name: 雛菜
text:
ん～でも、
一緒に見学するほうがいいかも～
trans:
Hm～
But maybe it's better if we both sit out the  class～

name: 雛菜
text:
その方が
いっぱいおしゃべりできるしね～？
trans: We'll be able to chat a lot if we do, right～?

name: 透
text:
やってるじゃん
今
trans:
That's what we're doing.
Right now.

name: 雛菜
text: じゃあこのままでいいね～
trans: Then it's good to keep chatting like this～

name: 体育教師
text: 見学の人も集まりなさい！
trans: Those who were sitting out, gather here as well!

name: 雛菜
text:
あは～
ばれちゃうから雛菜もう行こ～！
trans:
Aha～　Hinana should make a move first save she
gets caught～!

name: 雛菜
text: 透先輩も集合しなきゃだよ～？
trans: Toru-senpai better gather over there, too～?

name: 雛菜
text:
やは～
ちょうどチャイム鳴った！

name: 雛菜
text:
えらいから
２限目から出る！
trans: I'm a good girl, so I'll appear from the second period!

name: 雛菜
trans: I'll send you a message on Chain later～♡

name: 体育教師
text:
そこ！
早く集合しなさい！
trans:
Hey, you over there!
Get over here!

name: 雛菜
text:
ほら、透先輩
行って行って～……！

name: 透
trans: Yea. Hinana, you better go too.

name: 透
text:
３限目でもらっていい？
チェイン
trans:
Can you message me at the third period?
On Chain.

name: 透
trans:
It's PE, right?
The first period.
